name: move duplicate lookup before hashing references
scope: Local public Mailbox API; synthetic SQLite/filesystem scenarios, no model-quality/token/network claim

frozen_acceptance.correctness: exact reference outputs/rejection, all affected communication/usage tests; migration/reopen/fanout/cross-run no partial budget behavior
frozen_acceptance.improvement: For performance candidates >=1.25x primary median latency AND >=0.05ms absolute improvement, OR >=20% deterministic VM/instrumented operation reduction with non-regression latency; confirmation independent replay required
frozen_acceptance.guard: other scenarios candidate<=1.25x baseline OR<0.2ms added median; index candidates include initialization/storage/publish/ACK guard and history/late/absent workload
frozen_acceptance.safety: Never keep weakened hashing/root/identity/receipt/budget checks; adversarial cases demonstrate rejection
frozen_acceptance.negative: keep raw negative evidence; revert/defer/noise results count as evaluated rounds, not successful improvements
frozen_acceptance.index_guard: Initialization first-open latency recorded, reopen paired; database growth<=1.5x, migration existing DB/public roundtrip/restart; all timing guards same <=1.25x OR<0.2ms added, first-open guard<=2x OR<1ms added

primary_case: no keep, public trust/idempotency/isolation counterexamples; performance disabled
